title: Read Assist reader experience design backlog
scope: Approved reader features: page curl and bottom panel in 0.2.7; reading light, red failed sentences and speech reliability in 0.2.8

implementation.status: implemented; local release build, final focused tests and lint passed; signed CI validation pending
implementation.delivery: User authorized implementation, GitHub push and a downloadable APK.

direction.precedence: This book-like direction supersedes the app's existing swipe-right-for-next default and the older direction shown in the page-turn design preview.

behavior: Only the page viewport curls; the title bar and playback controls stay fixed.
The curl follows a deliberate one-finger horizontal drag, settles after a committed turn, and returns after a cancelled short drag.
Commit page navigation exactly once and update the page counter only after commitment.
Do not wrap past the first or last document page.
Preserve vertical scrolling, word selection, bookmarks, pinch-to-zoom, and zoomed PDF panning.
Animate existing document-page changes; screenful pagination for single-page articles is outside the currently proposed scope.
pageTurn.previousPreviewStatus: Visual reference remains useful; its old swipe direction is superseded by the explicit book-like direction above.

entry.control: Visible in-app drag handle in the bottom reader dock
actions: Swipe upward from the handle or its dock region
Tap the handle or its labelled controls target
entry.placement: Above the Android system navigation inset
gestureOwnership: Only gestures starting in the handle or dock region open the panel.
Upward gestures starting on the PDF continue to pan or scroll the document.
The open sheet intercepts its own gestures and prevents page turns beneath it.
Respect Android system gestures and preserve PDF pinch-to-zoom and zoomed panning.

states.name: closed
states.description: Reader content and compact playback dock remain visible, with the panel handle accessible.

states.name: quick
states.description: An 88%-height modal sheet opens fully within the visible window, with a scrolling quick-controls area and fixed playback transport.

states.name: expanded
states.description: A 94%-height expanded sheet exposes advanced settings and downloads while retaining the document position.

quickControls.label: Speech processing effort
quickControls.meaning: Controls speech and word-timing worker counts; does not change voice quality.

quickControls.label: Recognition detail
quickControls.meaning: Controls recognition image detail and retries independently of speech processing. High detail can take longer and consume more battery; it is not a guaranteed accuracy score.

quickControls.label: Voice model
quickControls.releaseSupport: Release builds support Kokoro with Misaki pronunciation only.
quickControls.availability: Show only model choices supported by the installed build and their actual installation state.
quickControls.debugOnlyAlternative: Pocket TTS with Alba MacKenna is present in the debug manifest and must not be presented as universally available in release builds.

advancedControls.label: Recognition model
advancedControls.availability: ML Kit is built in. PaddleOCR and TeleOCR require completed model installation before selection.

advancedControls.label: Apply to current page
advancedControls.meaning: Explicitly rerun recognition for the saved current page using the selected settings.

advancedControls.label: Show reading metrics
advancedControls.meaning: Expose actual measured speech generation, prepared listening buffer, buffering gaps, and extraction details. Do not invent live metrics or interpret speed as accuracy.

advancedControls.label: Voice models
advancedControls.meaning: Manage supported downloads and installation state while retaining the reader position.

advancedControls.label: Advanced performance
advancedControls.meaning: Keep technical tuning and benchmark actions out of the quick controls. Benchmarks remain a separate workflow.

currentSettingImpacts.currentBehavior: Stops playback, then writes the new preference. More threads can change speed, heat, and battery use; voice quality remains unchanged.
Stops playback, waits for active speech work, releases speech models, and then saves the new settings. Seamless uninterrupted speech is not currently supported by this settings path.
Saves the preference without automatically rerunning the current saved page.
Stops playback, cancels OCR refresh, closes OCR engines, and saves the selected model. Saved page text remains unchanged until explicit recognition is applied again.
The existing preview opens a separate sample document.
currentSettingImpacts.proposedRequirementIfIncluded: An in-panel preview must use new handling that preserves the PDF document, page, selection, and reading position. Do not reuse the existing navigation-changing sample action unchanged.

bottomControlPanel.savedTextBehavior: New pages use selected recognition settings. Previously saved pages retain their text and bookmarks until explicit Apply to current page. Reliable embedded PDF text continues to be used when available.

accessibilityAndMotion: Provide labelled tap controls as alternatives to swipe-only actions.
Use large touch targets, readable text, adequate contrast, and support for larger text sizes.
Give the sheet accessible dialog semantics and predictable focus; restore focus to its opener when closed.
Support dismissal through the close control, Android Back, and an appropriate downward sheet gesture.
Prevent hidden reader controls from receiving accessibility or pointer focus while the modal sheet is open.
Respect system reduced-motion settings with instant page changes or a minimal transition and reduced sheet motion.
Announce committed page and setting changes without announcing every drag frame.
Preserve page position, PDF zoom, and reading context when the panel opens or closes.
futureValidation: Test book-like next and previous direction, cancelled turns, first and last page boundaries, and exactly-once navigation.
Test dock opening against Android navigation gestures, PDF scrolling, pinch-to-zoom, zoomed panning, and horizontal page turns.
Test closed, quick, and expanded sheet states, Back dismissal, focus restoration, and large text.
Test model availability, voice and effort playback impacts, explicit OCR reruns, and slow recognition without losing document position.
Verify frame stability and memory use on Android hardware; browser or generated-image previews do not establish native performance.

upcomingDesigns.implementationStatus: User authorized all three features, GitHub push and signed APK delivery; implemented for 0.2.8, validation in progress.

readingLight.approval: User approved the reading-light preview and asked to retain it for the combined feature batch.
readingLight.placement: Reading light is the first card in Reader controls > Quick.

brightness.scope: A manual brightness override applies while reading; leaving the reader restores phone-controlled brightness.

controls: Warmth slider from Neutral to Warm with percentage
warmLight.appearance: A restrained translucent yellow overlay across the document viewport, including PDF images, extracted text and page-turn previews. Keep text readable and reader controls untinted.
warmLight.behavior: Preview changes immediately and retain the chosen strength when toggled off. Keep warmth independent of brightness and paper theme.

failedSpeechSentence.status: Implemented for 0.2.8 with red marking only
failedSpeechSentence.interpretation: Highlight the sentence whose voice-model audio generation failed. This interpretation has been stated to the user; OCR or missing-text failure is a separate case.
failedSpeechSentence.appearance: Mark the exact failed sentence red, keeping the words legible and the mark distinguishable over the warm-light overlay.
failedSpeechSentence.additionalUi: None. No new warning icon, error label, explanatory card, popup, retry button or skip button. The earlier recovery mockup is superseded by this explicit user correction.
failedSpeechSentence.behavior: Retain existing playback controls and failure behavior. Clear the red mark if audio for that sentence is successfully generated later. Do not mark user cancellation as a synthesis failure.
failedSpeechSentence.preparationAhead: Track the affected sentence without moving the reader away from the currently spoken sentence or adding a new status treatment.
failedSpeechSentence.implementationNotes: Revision-aware document/page/sentence tracking covers normalization and synthesis failures. Text spans and PDF word boxes remain red under bounded warmth; no new recovery UI. Complete successful sentence coverage clears marks; cancellation, global initialization, alignment and storage failures are excluded.

speechReliability.status: Implemented for 0.2.8: english-7 normalization and kokoro-v019-ipa-2 bounded pronunciation chunks
speechReliability.researchScope: Compare the relevant Chrome read-aloud pipeline with our normalization, speech planning, Misaki pronunciation and Kokoro synthesis. Evaluate other published methodologies for symbol handling and recovery.
speechReliability.constraints: Preserve document content, word mapping and highlighting. Distinguish contextual currency, percentage and mathematical symbols from stray markers; retain explicit validation for unsupported content.
speechReliability.comparisonClarification: User observed desktop/laptop Chrome, not Android Chrome.
speechReliability.confirmedCause: Both exact samples are rejected by EnglishNormalizer before Misaki/Kokoro. Explicit symbol-word expansions succeed in bounded host synthesis checks.

releaseUnitTests.scope: Final focused lighting and sentence-recovery rerun; full suite runs again in signed CI.

validation.releaseDistribution: GitHub signed release candidate, using the existing upload certificate
